line_items.desc: What Percent Off/Discount are you offering off of All Categories of your company catalog? This Catalog bid requires that a catalog be submitted to HCISD. Acceptable formats for catalogs are as follows: vendor's website, optical disks or paper catalogs. Published manufacturer suggested retail pricing or a price list must be included in the method of catalog provided. If paper catalogs or optical disks are being submitted the catalogs MUST arrive at HCISD Purchasing Department on or before due date and time of bid.
